answer_1.quote: To evaluate performance on multimodal tasks, we fine-tune the LLaVA-1.5 series models for visual instruction tuning, and then test the model for various visual QA benchmarks.
answer_1.outputs: Text responses to visual and textual inputs

answer_2.quote: All the evaluations are done using the VLMEvalKit (Contributors, 2023a). ... For MM-Vet, we report the average scores from the GPT-4-turbo.

answer_3.quote: For MathVista testmini, ... We report the accuracy scores on the testmini subset of 1,000 examples using GPT-4-turbo. ... For MM-Vet, we report the average scores from the GPT-4-turbo.

answer_4.quote: We also perform human evaluation on the generated images. ... 15 human experts are asked to independently score win/tie/loss for the paired images from LoRA and MoSLoRA.
answer_4.guideline: Experts evaluated based on subject similarity and prompt consistency.
